subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` make reconnect-and-replay the default response to an uncertain accepted Gateway run before using the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: This changes observable CLI behavior during disconnects, including waiting and result provenance, and the canonical linked issue explicitly requests maintainer direction on that policy.

options.title: Approve recover-first with retained fallback
options.body: Adopt the bounded reattach/wait/replay attempt as the default, then preserve the existing fresh-session embedded fallback when the original result remains unprovable.

options.title: Limit recovery to delivery-oriented runs
options.body: Use recover-first only where avoiding duplicate delivery outweighs loss of interactive fallback immediacy, while retaining current behavior for interactive stdout runs.

options.title: Keep immediate embedded fallback
options.body: Retain the existing fallback reflex and close this PR as a product direction not chosen for the CLI.

recommendation.title: Approve recover-first with retained fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the bounded reattach/wait/replay attempt as the default, then preserve the existing fresh-session embedded fallback when the original result remains unprovable.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor establishes the current accepted-disconnect fallback contract that this decision would modify.
